part: walking-surface slope from midstance, all 50 treadmill recordings

source.sha256_note: Recorded by earlier receipts; size and mtime re-checked before and after, bytes not rehashed.

method.frames: markers lab frame, up = +z (checked per recording), forward = median midstance heel->toe horizontal direction; plates in the local plate frame
method.sign: positive = uphill in the walking direction
method.midstance_frames: frames in 10-50 % of the stride with |v_heel - v_toe| <= 0.05 m/s (foot flat on the belt), >= 3 per stride; _25_35 variants use the fixed 25-35 % window
method.foot_pitch: heel->toe pitch at midstance minus the same participant and leg level-walking (i0) median
method.belt_path: pitch of the flat foot path (mean heel/toe velocity) at midstance; no offset
method.plate_units_note: stride-mean |GRF| equals body mass x g, so forceplate force is in N, not the README N/kg
method.plate_force: tilt of the stride-mean total GRF from the plate normal; plate +y sign from braking/propulsion order

tolerance_rule: Per method: residual r = recording median - label over recordings that are not i0 and not AB01 i5/i10; tol = max(1.0, ceil_to_0.5(|median r| + 4 * 1.4826 * MAD(r))) deg; flag when |r| > tol. Fixed in code and computed in a blind run before the AB01 i5/i10 values were looked at.
